review_findings.summary: The legacy semantic metadata hot-swap mutated current in place and used a second lock implementation that could race or delete the shared lock identity.
review_findings.resolution: Commit bd1c74c9 removes the hot-swap and its create/delete lock; every semantic publish now uses ImmutableReleaseStore, with a public regression proving candidate-to-current and current-to-previous behavior. Kimi final rereview returned PASS.

review_findings.summary: Concurrent cold-root openers could both observe an empty lock file and a late initializer could reset an already advanced fencing token to zero.
review_findings.resolution: Commit 36400e67 creates a fully written and fsynced temporary inode and exposes it with a create-only hard link; concurrent creators converge on the winner without writing the live lock. A deterministic interleaving test changed from token 1 versus 0 to equal tokens.

review_findings.summary: The initial publication epoch write was not fsynced before the lock became usable.
review_findings.resolution: Commit 36400e67 fsyncs the initialized inode before linking it at .publish.lock; the focused Doubao rereview returned PASS with zero blocking findings.

review_findings.summary: One reviewer requested preservation of the older previous release across a metadata-only publication.
review_findings.resolution: Rejected as a contract change: ImmutableReleaseStore intentionally retains the immediate prior current as the single previous rollback target and archives the older previous. The immutable publication fix preserves that approved behavior.
